sloka: प्रतिप्रविष्टे लङ्कां तु कृतार्थे रावणात्मजे ।राघवं परिवार्यार्ता ररक्षुर्वानरर्षभाः ।। ६.४७.१ ।।।।
transliteration: pratipraviṣṭe laṅkāṁ tu kṛtārthe rāvaṇātmaje ।rāghavaṁ parivāryārtā rarakṣurvānararṣabhāḥ ।। 6.47.1 ।।।।

translations.english: After accomplishing the task Ravana's son entered Lanka while the bull among monkeys guarded Raghava staying around.
